body.name: polar_r
body.def: if \(A=P\operatorname{diag}(s_1,\ldots,s_r)Q^{\top}\) is the full singular-value decomposition with decreasing singular values and lexicographically selected bases and signs at every tie and zero singular value, then \(\operatorname{polar}_r(A)=PQ^{\top}\)
body.role: measurable Procrustes solution on singular as well as nonsingular inputs
